0022600115.text: The Raptors come into this game 2-0 on a two-game winning streak, sitting 2nd in the Atlantic and 3rd in the East, while the Timberwolves are also 2-0 on a two-game streak and sit 3rd in the Northwest and 6th in the West. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but in 2025-26 Toronto lost both games in the series, most recently 115-107 in Minneapolis on March 5, 2026. Brandon Ingram (heel, surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot, fracture) are out for the Raptors, and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery) is out for Minnesota.
